target: Qt 6.8.4 Linux x86_64, glibc 2.17 floor (RHEL 7.6 in Qt 5.15's platform list)

build.base: centos:7.9.2009, devtoolset-11 GCC 11, static OpenSSL 3.5.7, static xcb-util-cursor 0.1.5
build.highest_imports: GLIBC_2.17; no GLIBCXX or CXXABI versions

runtime.image: centos:7.6.1810 with packages from its own 7.6 base repository only (no updates, EPEL or Developer Toolset)
runtime.packages: mesa-libGL mesa-libEGL mesa-dri-drivers dbus libX11 libX11-xcb libxcb xcb-util xcb-util-image xcb-util-keysyms xcb-util-renderutil xcb-util-wm libxkbcommon libxkbcommon-x11 fontconfig freetype dejavu-sans-fonts xorg-x11-server-Xvfb xorg-x11-xauth

notes: Linked libraries: libGL, libEGL, libX11, libX11-xcb, libxcb and xcb-util (icccm, image, keysyms, render-util), libxkbcommon(-x11); xcb-util-cursor and OpenSSL are static.
An earlier build linked GLVND libOpenGL.so.0 and needed libglvnd-opengl, which 7.6 does not install with mesa-libGL; fixed by linking libGL.so.1.
Container setup a real RHEL 7 desktop already has: Mesa swrast DRI driver and a non-empty /etc/machine-id (libdbus aborts on an empty one).
